intro: These are federally allocated and identical in every state. Load them into your VX-6 once and they will be useful for the rest of the radio's life.
introz: 以下频率由联邦统一分配，全美各州完全一致。在 VX-6 里存一次，之后走到哪里都能用。

stations.d: One of seven national weather channels. Continuous forecasts plus SAME emergency alerts.
stations.dz: 全国七个气象频道之一。连续播报天气预报，并发送 SAME 紧急警报。

stations.d: Scan all seven and keep whichever is strongest — coverage areas overlap so neighbouring transmitters use different channels.
stations.dz: 七个都扫一遍，留信号最强的。相邻发射台会错开频道，所以覆盖区是交叠的。

stations.d: International distress frequency for civil aviation. Normally dead silent — traffic on it means something is wrong.
stations.dz: 国际民航遇险频率。平时完全静默——一旦有通话就意味着出事了。

stations.d: Military counterpart to 121.5. In the VX-6's 225–380 MHz military airband.
stations.dz: 121.5 的军用对应频率，位于 VX-6 可覆盖的 225–380 MHz 军航波段。

stations.d: Pilots coordinating between aircraft, away from ATC.
stations.dz: 飞行员之间的协调通话，不经管制。

stations.d: Not an official channel, but famously used by airline crews over oceans and empty airspace. Often the most human thing on the airband.
stations.dz: 严格说不是正式频道，但航空公司机组在跨洋和空旷空域广泛使用。航空波段上最有人味的内容。

stations.d: Most common self-announce frequency at small airports with no tower. Also 122.700, 122.900, 123.000.
stations.dz: 无塔台小机场最常用的自主通报频率。另有 122.700、122.900、123.000。

stations.d: Airborne activity without a ground station: firefighting aircraft, glider ops, crop dusting, parachute drops.
stations.dz: 无地面站的空中作业：消防飞机、滑翔机、农药喷洒、跳伞。

stations.z: 2 米全国 FM 呼叫频率
stations.d: The single most useful ham memory in the US. Direct radio-to-radio, no repeater. If you are somewhere remote and want to find a human, call here.
stations.dz: 全美最实用的一个业余频率。电台直连，不经中继。人在荒郊野外想找人，就在这里呼叫。

stations.z: 70 厘米全国 FM 呼叫频率
stations.d: UHF equivalent of 146.520.
stations.dz: 146.520 的 UHF 对应频率。

stations.d: The VX-6 transmits on 1.25 m, which is unusual for a handheld — this band is quiet and worth a listen.
stations.dz: VX-6 能在 1.25 米发射，手台里少见。这个波段很清静，值得一听。

stations.d: Position-reporting packet bursts. You will hear a rapid modem chirp every few seconds — good sanity check that your radio and squelch work.
stations.dz: 位置上报数据包。每隔几秒会听到短促的调制声——用来确认电台和静噪工作正常很方便。

stations.z: 海事 16 频道 · 遇险呼叫
stations.d: International hailing and distress. Monitored by the Coast Guard everywhere there is water.
stations.dz: 国际呼叫与遇险频道。凡有水域的地方海岸警卫队都在守听。

stations.z: 海事 13 频道 · 船桥互通
stations.d: Ship manoeuvring and passing arrangements. Where the actual work happens in a busy harbour.
stations.dz: 船舶操纵与会让协调。繁忙港口里真正干活的频道。

stations.d: Coast Guard broadcasts safety notices and weather here after announcing on Ch 16.
stations.dz: 海警在 16 频道预告后，在此播发安全通告和气象。

stations.z: 海事 09 频道 · 呼叫
stations.d: Secondary hailing channel for recreational boats, keeping Ch 16 clear.
stations.dz: 游艇的次呼叫频道，用于给 16 频道让路。

stations.z: 海事 14 频道 · 港务与船舶交通
stations.d: Vessel Traffic Service in most major US ports. Essentially air traffic control for ships.
stations.dz: 美国多数大港的船舶交通管理服务，相当于船舶的空管。

stations.z: 海事 72 频道 · 船间闲聊
stations.d: Non-commercial chatter between boats.
stations.dz: 游艇之间的非商业通话。

stations.d: Consumer walkie-talkies. Channels 1–7 are 462.5625–462.7125 in 12.5 kHz steps. Very active at trailheads, ski resorts and campgrounds.
stations.dz: 民用对讲机频段。1–7 频道为 462.5625–462.7125，间隔 12.5 kHz。步道口、雪场、营地非常活跃。

stations.z: GMRS 20 频道 · 出行与求助
stations.d: Traditional REACT / traveller-assistance channel on GMRS.
stations.dz: GMRS 上的传统 REACT 互助与出行求助频道。

stations.d: A VHF business and personal band. Five channels: 151.820, 151.880, 151.940, 154.570, 154.600. Used by ranches, film crews, race staff.
The old blister-pack walkie-talkie channel. Still surprisingly busy in retail and warehouses.
stations.dz: 早年廉价对讲机的默认频道。零售店和仓库里意外地还很热闹。

stations.z: VCALL10 全国 VHF 互通呼叫
stations.d: Nationwide mutual-aid calling channel. Analog, so your VX-6 can hear it. Tactical follow-ons VTAC11 151.1375, VTAC12 154.4525, VTAC13 158.7375, VTAC14 159.4725.
stations.dz: 全国互助呼叫频道，模拟制式，VX-6 可收。战术频道：VTAC11 151.1375、VTAC12 154.4525、VTAC13 158.7375、VTAC14 159.4725。

stations.z: UCALL40 全国 UHF 互通呼叫
stations.d: UHF mutual aid. Tacticals UTAC41 453.4625, UTAC42 453.7125, UTAC43 453.8625.
Legacy nationwide ambulance-to-hospital channel. Still used in many regions for patient reports.
stations.dz: 传统的全国救护车—医院频道。许多地区仍用于交接病情。

stations.d: Federal wildland-fire aviation emergency and flight-following channel, identical nationwide. During fire season this is one of the most interesting frequencies in the country.
stations.dz: 联邦野火航空紧急与航迹跟踪频率，全国统一。火季期间是全美最有意思的频率之一。

stations.d: Park Service operations sit in the federal 162–174 MHz block. Individual parks differ — scan 162–174 MHz on arrival rather than trusting one number.
stations.dz: 国家公园局业务集中在联邦 162–174 MHz 段。各公园不同——到了当地直接扫 162–174 MHz，不要只信一个数字。

stations.d: US railroads use 160.215–161.565 MHz in 15 kHz steps. Scanning that whole span near any mainline will find the local road channel and defect-detector announcements.
stations.dz: 美国铁路使用 160.215–161.565 MHz，间隔 15 kHz。在任何干线附近扫这一整段，就能找到当地行车频道和轴温探测报音。

stations.z: Amtrak 行车频道（东部常用）
stations.d: Widely used on the Northeast Corridor and by Amtrak crews elsewhere.
stations.dz: 东北走廊广泛使用，其他线路的 Amtrak 车组也常用。

stations.d: Data bursts between the locomotive and the last car. Not voice, but a reliable way to confirm a train is nearby.
stations.dz: 机车与列尾之间的数据突发。不是语音，但可以可靠判断附近有车。

stations.d: Astronauts talking to schools during ARISS contacts. Handheld with a stock antenna is genuinely enough if the pass is high.
stations.dz: ARISS 活动中航天员与学校通话。过顶仰角高时，手台配原装天线真的能收到。

stations.z: 国际空间站 APRS 转发
stations.d: Packet bursts on every pass, far more often than voice.
stations.dz: 每次过顶都有数据包，比语音活跃得多。

stations.d: A working FM repeater in orbit. Downlink drifts roughly ±10 kHz across a pass from Doppler — the VX-6's dial makes chasing it easy.
stations.dz: 在轨的 FM 中继。多普勒会让下行在过顶过程中漂移约 ±10 kHz——VX-6 的旋钮很适合手动追频。

stations.d: Analog weather-image transmission. Sounds like a metronome ticking. Record the audio and software can decode an actual cloud photo. Also NOAA-15 on 137.620 and NOAA-18 on 137.9125.
stations.dz: 模拟气象图传，听起来像节拍器。录下音频用软件能解出真实云图。另有 NOAA-15 137.620、NOAA-18 137.9125。

stations.d: Atomic clock ticks and a voice time announcement from Fort Collins, Colorado. Also 2.5, 5, 15 and 20 MHz. The VX-6 tunes down to 500 kHz, so this works — reception quality varies with time of day and ionosphere.
stations.dz: 科罗拉多 Fort Collins 发出的原子钟秒信号与语音报时。另有 2.5、5、15、20 MHz。VX-6 最低可调到 500 kHz，所以能收——效果随时段和电离层变化。

stations.z: 美空军全球高频指挥网
stations.d: US Air Force High Frequency Global Communications System. Encrypted alphanumeric broadcasts read aloud by robotic voices. Also 8.992, 11.175 and 15.016 MHz. Eerie listening, and easy to find.
stations.dz: 美国空军全球高频通信系统。合成语音朗读加密字母数字串。另有 8.992、11.175、15.016 MHz。听起来很诡异，而且不难找到。

stations.d: Low-power AM loops at park entrances with road, wildlife and closure info. Usually 1610 kHz, sometimes 530 or 1710. Signed on the roadside.
stations.dz: 公园入口的小功率中波循环播报：路况、野生动物、封闭信息。通常 1610 kHz，有时 530 或 1710。路边有牌子提示。
